name: Solve this quantum programming problem. Write a complete QAOA MaxCut solver in Q
task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Write a complete QAOA MaxCut solver in Qiskit (depth p=1) for edges [(0, 3), (0, 5), (1, 2), (1, 3), (1, 5), (2, 3), (2, 4), (2, 5), (3, 4)], including manual cost/mixer construction, classical optimization, and sampling of the final state. Write the full runnable code (all imports included); executing it should print the results.
